title: VanillaPlus Enchants
description: Adds new vanilla-style utility enchantments you can get right at the enchanting table.
body:
# VanillaPlus Enchants

A set of **17 useful, vanilla-style enchantments**. All of them can be obtained
**at the enchanting table** and on books — no new blocks, ores, or GUIs.


<details>
<summary>Mining & Tools</summary>

## :pick: Mining & Tools
- **Auto Smelt** (pickaxe) — ore drops already smelted. Rare and expensive.
- **Lumberjack** (axe, I–III) — fells the whole tree at once.
- **Bulldozer** (pickaxe, I–III) — mines a 3×3 area, depth scales with level. Easy on durability.
- **Excavator** (shovel, I–III) — same, but for dirt/sand/gravel.
- **Vein Miner** (pickaxe) — mines a whole ore vein at once.
- **Magnet** (pickaxe/axe) — ore/wood goes straight to your inventory.
- **Wisdom** (tools, I–III) — more XP from mined blocks.

</details>




<details>
<summary>Held & Worn Effects</summary>

## :shield: Held & Worn Effects
- **Haste** (tool, I–II) — faster mining.
- **Fury** (sword, I–II) — Strength while held.
- **Miner's Lantern** (helmet) — gives off light around you while worn.
- **Aqua Lung** (helmet) — breathe underwater.
- **Fireproof** (chestplate) — fire resistance.
- **Sprint** (boots, I–II) — movement speed.
- **Nourish** (chestplate) — keeps your hunger from bottoming out (slight slowdown).
- **Step Assist** (boots) — auto-step up one block.

</details>




<details>
<summary>Combat</summary>

## :crossed_swords: Combat
- **Lifesteal** (sword, I–II) — heal a little on hit.
**Beheading** (sword/axe, I–II) — chance to drop the mob's head.

</details>
